dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two distinct white horizontal bands are clearly visible; the lower band on the greater coverts is thicker and exhibits higher grayscale contrast against the dark blue-grey wing than the thinner median-covert band.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence; the folded secondary and tertial feathers show sharp, bright white linear boundaries that are distinct against the darker feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A thin, high-contrast black semi-circular band is visible at the transition from the nape to the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive white outer rectrices (tail feathers) creating a high-contrast perimeter around the darker central tail feathers.
